sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the cleft sentence with *lo que* from B2 Unit 1: *lo que* + verb + *ser* + the idea you want to stress, and *fue* + place or time + *donde* or *cuando*. They suit a text about Atacama, where one fact is often the news: what explains the dryness, where ALMA stands, when it opened.

sections.title: Three ways to spotlight a fact
rows: Lo que explica la sequedad de Atacama es la geografía.
*lo que* + verb + *ser*: the explanation is the geography
Fue en 2013 cuando se inauguró ALMA.
*fue* + time + *cuando*: it was in 2013 that ALMA opened
Fue en el llano de Chajnantor donde se instaló ALMA.
*fue* + place + *donde*: it was on the Chajnantor plateau that ALMA was built
Son los Andes los que detienen la humedad del este.
*son* + plural + *los que*: it is the Andes that stop the moisture

items.spanish: Lo que hace especial a Atacama es su cielo despejado.
items.english: What makes Atacama special is its clear sky.

items.spanish: Fue en 2013 cuando se inauguró ALMA.
items.english: It was in 2013 that ALMA was inaugurated.

items.spanish: Fue en el cerro Paranal donde se instaló el Very Large Telescope.
items.english: It was on Cerro Paranal that the Very Large Telescope was set up.

items.spanish: Son los Andes los que detienen la humedad que viene del este.
items.english: It is the Andes that stop the moisture coming from the east.

sections.content: *Ser* follows the time of the other verb (*Lo que explica… es*, *Fue en 2013 cuando…*), and it agrees with a plural focus (*Son los Andes los que…*). Use a cleft sentence for the one fact you want the listener to remember, not in every sentence.
